title: Point valuations
description: Cents per point for each currency or program, supplied and maintained by the site owner. Published on the Ranking Methodology page. Draft.

values.description: Map of currency id (currencies.json) or program id (programs.json, for co-branded cards) to cents per point. 'cash' is fixed at 1. A value is either a single number, or for currencies with an unlocking card (Chase UR, Citi TYP, Capital One) an object with a 'withUnlocker' and a 'withoutUnlocker' number.

notes.description: Optional explanation per id, shown on the Ranking Methodology page.

freeNightCertificates.description: Dollar value of one free night certificate by type, using Frequent Miler's discounted (fudge factor) values.
